configs.description: The finger duct as FS ships #315741, both covers fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: no FS document held states a cable capacity for CMH-DFDS1U: the datasheet that covers it has no Cable Capacity Reference Guide, and the cable managers portfolio lists only dimensions. The product page could not be read (403 from the shop front).
gaps.wanted: the capacity row of the product page, or a capacity table in a later datasheet

gaps.note: no view draws the backbone face. Gallery image 3 of #315741 shows light through it in two places across the open front channel; the openings are not drawn, and the backbone is drawn solid.
gaps.wanted: a straight view of the backbone with a cover off
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - style, sides, material and the UL 94 V-0 rating of the finger ducts are the Technical Specification table and overview of the FS High Capacity Horizontal Cable Managers datasheet (portal id 7671); indoor its Environment row.

backbone.note: estimated - the backbone is drawn 44 high, centred, the height of the ears it runs into; no view shows it end-on. The plan puts it at the middle of the 230.6.

backbone-holes.note: photo-measured - gallery image 3 of #315741 shows light through the backbone in two places across the open front channel, so it may be pierced as the single-sided backbones are; no view gives the openings. Drawn solid; see the gap.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom row of fingers is the top row again.

capacity.note: not stated - no capacity is carried: the high capacity datasheet has no capacity figure and the cable managers portfolio gives dimensions only, so the figure is the `cable-capacity` gap below, not a datasheet fact.

chassis.note: drawing - THE BODY BETWEEN THE EARS. 482.61 over the ears; the cover between them reads 388 of 421.5 px, 444, which at this resolution is the 440 of the family to two pixels a side; 440 is taken. The ears are not drawn. Depth 230.6 is the plan and the spec table.

color.note: estimated - no colour row in the datasheet; every render is black, drawn in the shades CMH-SFDS1U reads off its renders.

fingers.note: drawing - ten fingers a row each side on the plan, stems 38.8 px apart, 44.4, the moulding of the other steel ducts; 44.0 is taken so that ten fill the 440 body. The fork of each stem is drawn as the stem.

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted, 440 x 57.8, with four hinge clips staggered as on the front view: two on the top edge at 77.9 and 343.6 from the left end and two on the bottom at 121.4 and 300.0. The finger rows are 9.0 thick and 4.7 in from the top and bottom, ESTIMATED: there is no side view, and they are taken from the same moulding on CMH-SFDS1U and CMH-DFDS2U.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - a dual-sided duct bolts to the front rails with its fingers facing both ways: it stands 115.3 mm to each side of its backbone (the plan, 230.6 over both covers), so it serves the face it is bolted to and the space just behind the rails, and at 230.6 mm it does not reach the rear rails of a rack. The rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - one duct on each of the front and rear views, the channel between the finger rows.

height.note: drawing - 57.8, AS THE DRAWING DIMENSIONS IT, TALLER THAN ITS RACK UNIT. The front view puts the 57.81 dimension on the cover, from its top edge to its bottom edge, and draws the ears inside it, top and bottom; the ear holes are dimensioned 32.00 apart. The spec table and the portfolio state 57.8. So the covers overhang the ears and the 1U they fill by about 7 mm above and below, and the chassis is drawn 57.8 high in a 1U part. Two readings disagree with the figure and are not taken: the same front view, scaled off its own ear holes, draws the cover 54.2; the straight-on render reads 49 to 51.5 against the 440 width, as CMH-SFDS1U reads its own 51 by the same method.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn; the end elevation is built from the plan depths and the estimated rows. Both channels are open at the ends.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS High Capacity Horizontal Cable Managers datasheet (portal id 7671) draws CMH-DFDS1U as a plan and a front view, dimensioned 482.61, 465.11, 57.81, 32.00 and 230.60. The embedded image is small (647 x 529, watermarked): 0.873 px/mm across the 482.61 and 0.872 along the 230.6, and resolves about 1.2 mm. The straight-on render of the front (gallery image 5) and the plan render (image 4) are the second reading.

rear.note: drawing - the rear channel is the front channel turned round, as the plan draws it.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT ON EACH SIDE. A sheet body whose views are elevations. The front and rear views each carry the backbone as a well 114.7 deep, its floor the backbone, the two rows of fingers standing in it and a cover that comes off; the two floors stand 1.2 apart.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states the gauge; 1.2 is taken, as for the other FS steel managers in the library.

top.note: drawing - the plan, rear cover at y=0: the rear channel, the backbone at the middle, the front channel.

weight.note: datasheet - 1.65 kg, the FS product page specification for #315741, as read at intake.
